business_problem: Shoppers are looking for coupons to save money, and merchants are using coupons to attract shoppers, increase sales, and improve customer loyalty. However, in the process of expanding and upgrading its business, the company encountered a number of technical challenges: The difficulty and long development cycle in large-scale, real-time data governance: CouponBirds has built a large user base and a large database of merchants thanks to 9 years in the industry.
solution_summary: Founded in 2015, CouponBirds provides information about high-quality discounts and coupons to online shoppers worldwide. To efficiently handle the growing data traffic and improve user experience, CouponBirds adopted AWS products like Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Amazon Data Firehose, AWS Lambda, Amazon OpenSearch Service, Amazon ELB, Amazon CloudSearch, Amazon Personalize, AWS IAM, and Amazon VPC,to build a new data governance architecture. This new data governance architecture allows CouponBirds to be better-positioned to address the needs of its users around the world while driving ongoing innovation and business growth. Founded in 2015, CouponBirds provides information about high-quality discounts and coupons to online shoppers worldwide, helping millions of them get more with less each month.

solution_components.name: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
solution_components.role: Captures and buffers high-volume event streams from source systems.

solution_components.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
solution_components.role: Stores searchable indexes or vectors and serves low-latency search and analytics queries.

solution_components.name: Amazon Data Firehose
solution_components.role: Delivers streaming data into downstream storage and analytics services.

solution_components.name: Amazon CloudSearch
solution_components.role: Powers low-latency search experiences inside the application.

solution_components.name: Amazon Personalize
solution_components.role: Generates personalized recommendations for end users.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Runs event-driven compute for real-time processing without server management.

solution_components.name: Amazon ELB
solution_components.role: Balances traffic across application instances during demand spikes.

solution_components.name: Amazon VPC
solution_components.role: Isolates workloads and network segments inside secure private cloud boundaries.

solution_components.name: AWS IAM
solution_components.role: Controls authentication and authorization across AWS resources.

data_flow: Source data is ingested through Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Amazon Data Firehose, stored or indexed in Amazon OpenSearch Service, processed with AWS Lambda, and delivered through Amazon CloudSearch, Amazon Personalize.
business_outcome: A 4-time improvement of data governance and a 50% cost reduction for data processing By using data stream processing tools like Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and Amazon Data Firehose, CouponBirds is able to easily handle large-scale data streams from multiple sources and improve its system’s data governancee by 4 times. In addition, it also uses multiple fully managed products and services of AWS to significantly reduce the cost of data governance by 50%. Key reported metrics include improvement in data governance 4x; 4x; cost reduction in data governance 50%.
